BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


S E C T I O N 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance be amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached

House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 12-F in the area

bounded by

       A line 353.31 feet south ofthe intersection of West 54''^ Street as measured
       along the west right-of-way line of South Dearborn Street and perpendicular
       thereto; South Dearborn Street; a line 378.31 feet south of the intersection
       of West 54'^ Street as measured along the West right-of-way line of South
       Dearborn Street and perpendicular thereto; and the alley next west of and
       Pai-allel to South Dearborn Street,


to those of a RT4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.


S E C T I O N 3. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.
